I studied "Media Technology" (Bachelors Degree) and "Interactive Technologies" (Masters degree) at the St. Pölten University of Applied Sciences. Over the last couple of years, I have come to realize how much i really enjoy coding and creating applications of all kinds. With this regard, i dont really have much of a preference when it comes to tech stacks or programming languages (nowadays i'm doing a lot with React, which i enjoy quite a bit).

Because I discovered my interest in programming only a couple of years ago, I still have a lot to learn. However, I am eager to learn, and consider this to be one of my biggest strengths. I am always willing and open to learn and tackle any technologies or projects, as long as I am given the freedom to grow with the given task.
